data.name: Kamta
data.long_meaning: In Sanskrit, Kamta means 'desire' or 'love'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'kama', which represents pleasure, desire, or love. In Hindu mythology, Kamadeva is the god of desire and love, and the name Kamta is associated with the divine energy of love and passion.
